prerequisites: familiarity with the Creo Parametric environment (Expresión Gráfica, 2º cuatrimestre de 2º curso)

learning_outcomes.text: To train the student in the fundamentals of analytical mechanics and prepare them for the study of the dynamics of machines and mechanisms.
To introduce the student to multibody simulations (MBS), by performing a set of practical exercises and a project in the Creo Parametric environment.

syllabus_topics: Mechanics of rigid bodies: Newton's laws of motion.
D'Alembert principle. Application to rigid bodies.
Application of the Principle of Virtual Work to solve instantaneous problems.
Principles of conservation. Ignorable coordinates and Conservation of the generalized momentum.
Guided application case in Creo Parametric.
Unit 4. 3D kinematics and dynamics of rigid bodies
Motion about a fixed point: Euler's angles.
Rotation of systems about a fixed axis: time derivative of vectors, equations of motion, constraint reactions, obtention of applied torques.
teaching_methods: Student study based on different sources of information
Personal interview with the course professor (addressing doubts)
assessment_rules: For the ordinary examination, the final grade is composed of a partial exam (15%), an individual project (15%), and a final exam (70%). The partial exam is liberatory if the student achieves 50% or more of its value; otherwise, it must be retaken on the day of the final exam. For the extraordinary examination, approved liberatory partial exam grades and individual project grades are retained. The final exam then accounts for 70%, plus the 15% for the partial exam if not previously passed.
